questions.question: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in dollars?
A snail is at the bottom of a 10 meter well. Each day it climbs up 3 meters, and each night it slips back 2 meters. On which day does it first reach the top and escape?
At a party, every person shook hands with every other person exactly once. There were 66 handshakes in total. How many people were at the party?
How many times does the digit 7 appear when you write out all of the integers from 1 to 1000 inclusive?
In how many different ways can you make change for exactly one dollar using any number of pennies, nickels, dimes, and quarters?
What is the smallest positive integer that cannot be written as the sum of at most three perfect squares? (1, 4, 9, 16, ... are perfect squares; a square may be reused.)
